name: attach
description: Self-hosted Cloudflare kit for PR/validation media uploads

scripts.ready: vp check && pnpm --filter @uinaf/attach-api types:check && vp run -r test && vp run -t @uinaf/attach-web#build && vp run -t @uinaf/attach-api#build && vp run -t @uinaf/attach-cli#build
scripts.build: vp run -t @uinaf/attach-web#build && vp run -t @uinaf/attach-api#build && vp run -t @uinaf/attach-cli#build
scripts.deploy: pnpm exec vp run -t @uinaf/attach-web#build && node apps/api/scripts/deploy.ts
